# Project Instructions

- Build the mobile app with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript.
- Keep the initial app dependency-light and follow existing project patterns.
- Keep `App.tsx` as the Expo entry point; put screens in `src/screens/` and reusable UI in `src/components/`.
- Keep component styles in neighboring `.styles.ts` files and shared visual tokens in `src/theme/`.
- Add dependencies only when a specific feature needs them; prefer React Native and Expo APIs already in the project.
- Do not add a backend, persistence, CSV import, or notifications until requested.
- Keep Russian UI copy clear and concise.
- Run `npm run typecheck` after TypeScript changes when dependencies are installed.
